details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTP POST of a JSON body to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc carrying the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory, the current working directory and the npm user the publisher, tagged with an X-Beacon-Package header. index.js repeats the same beacon whenever the module is required, so a consumer build that imports the name also calls back. The payload is limited to host and install metadata: no credentials, tokens, environment values, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted, and no further code is downloaded or executed.
